❗ Most Trading Problems Aren't About Strategy  

Many traders blame their strategy, but the real issue is emotion. Losses often follow a valid trade → stop-out → frustration → revenge trades → bigger losses. Discipline fades, accounts suffer.  

Try this:  
Check past months. Split losing days into:  
📊 Followed plan (normal losses)  
🛍 Broke rules (revenge, overtrading, moved stops)  

Remove the second group. Reassess. Most realize: a few emotional days wipe out weeks of progress.  

Your journal should track:  
🪙 When do I break rules?  
🪙 After how many losses does judgment slip?  
🪙 Do I make mistakes at a certain time?  
🪗 What mistake costs most long-term?  

These insights beat another chart pattern. Lasting traders aren’t mistake-free — they notice emotion rising and walk away before one bad trade becomes ten.
